rule: Shorewood lists admission for up to six guests per pass. Children must be accompanied by an adult 18 or older.

operator_name: Toronto Public Library → Aga Khan Museum
item: Check how many people it covers
rule: General admission covers up to two adults including the cardholder. Ages 25 and under are free. Children age 14 or younger need an adult.

rule: This route uses a digital library pass. There is no physical library pass in the Aquarium’s published instructions.

operator_name: Shorewood Library → Betty Brinn Children’s Museum
item: Return a physical pass
rule: Return it to Shorewood Library. The regular loan period is three days with a three-day grace period.

operator_name: Berkshire Athenaeum → MASS MoCA
item: Return a physical pass
rule: The library’s standard passes normally come back the next morning. Facsimile passes do not come back. Confirm the format on your booking.

operator_name: Burlington County Library System → participating venues
